"use client"

import { Checkbox as CheckboxPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/checkbox"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/**
 * Checkbox: 14px surface box with a hairline ring and two soft drops, a faint
 * bottom shade that clears on hover, brand fill with a drawn check when checked and a dash when indeterminate.
 */
function Checkbox({ className, ...props }: CheckboxPrimitive.Root.Props) {
  return (
    <CheckboxPrimitive.Root
      data-slot="checkbox"
      className={cn(
        "peer group/checkbox relative inline-flex size-3.5 after:absolute after:-inset-x-2.5 after:-inset-y-2 pointer-coarse:after:inset-x-[min(0px,calc((100%_-_44px)/2))] pointer-coarse:after:inset-y-[min(0px,calc((100%_-_36px)/2))] group-has-disabled/field:opacity-50 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-sm bg-surface text-brand-foreground transition outline-none",
        "shadow-control",
        "before:absolute before:inset-0 before:rounded-[inherit] before:bg-linear-to-b before:to-black/2 before:transition-opacity hover:bg-accent hover:before:opacity-0 hover:shadow-control-hover",
        "data-checked:bg-brand data-checked:shadow-control-checked data-checked:hover:bg-brand data-indeterminate:bg-brand data-indeterminate:shadow-control-checked data-indeterminate:hover:bg-brand",
        // Forced colours (Windows high contrast): a CanvasText box, Highlight with a HighlightText check when checked.
        "forced-colors:bg-[Canvas] forced-colors:text-[HighlightText] forced-colors:outline-1 forced-colors:[--tw-outline-style:solid] forced-colors:-outline-offset-1 forced-colors:outline-[CanvasText] forced-colors:forced-color-adjust-none forced-colors:before:hidden forced-colors:data-checked:bg-[Highlight] forced-colors:data-indeterminate:bg-[Highlight] forced-colors:focus-visible:outline-2 forced-colors:focus-visible:outline-offset-2 forced-colors:focus-visible:outline-[CanvasText]",
        "focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:[--tw-outline-style:solid] focus-visible:outline-ring aria-invalid:bg-destructive/10 aria-invalid:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--destructive)] data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:opacity-40",
                className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <CheckboxPrimitive.Indicator data-slot="checkbox-indicator" keepMounted className="relative grid place-content-center">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5 *:transition-[stroke-dashoffset] *:duration-200 *:ease-out motion-reduce:*:transition-none">
          <path
            d="M4.25 8.75 7.25 11.75 11.75 4.25"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.5"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            className="[stroke-dasharray:14] [stroke-dashoffset:14] group-data-checked/checkbox:[stroke-dashoffset:0]"
          />
          <path
            d="M4.5 8h7"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.5"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            className="[stroke-dasharray:7] [stroke-dashoffset:7] group-data-indeterminate/checkbox:[stroke-dashoffset:0]"
          />
        </svg>
      </CheckboxPrimitive.Indicator>
    </CheckboxPrimitive.Root>
  )
}

export { Checkbox }
